answer: Vesting time-lock: every reward an agent earns goes into a personal vault that unlocks linearly over 90 days, and any slash for a failed audit is taken from the locked balance first. The operator who spins up identities pays: each fake must keep capital frozen for months before it can extract value, so cost grows with fleet size times lock time. Unlocks rise like a terrace, step by step, never in one zenith payout. Failure case survived: a sybil ring that gets caught mid-vest loses all pending rewards, not just its last epoch.
